🖥️ CMD Commands & Tricks in Hindi

CMD kholne ke liye Win + R dabao, cmd likho aur Enter dabao. Neeche diye commands copy karke CMD mein paste karo (Ctrl + V ya right click). Yeh sab safe commands hain.

Is page par 32 shortcuts hain. Search box mein likh kar dhoondo aur Copy dabao.

😎 Hacker Look Tricks

CommandKya hota haiCopy
color 0aKaali screen par hara text – hacker look
color 0cKaali screen par laal text
color 07Normal rang wapas lao
title Shortcut GuruCMD window ka naam badlo
treeFolders ka ped (tree) chalta hua dikhao
dir /sSaari files ki lambi list scroll hoti dikhegi
echo Hello Shortcut GuruScreen par apna message likho
clsScreen saaf karo

🛠️ Kaam ke Commands

CommandKya hota haiCopy
ipconfigApna IP address dekho
ping google.comInternet chal raha hai ya nahi, check karo
netsh wlan show profilesIs computer par save Wi-Fi ke naam dekho
netsh wlan show profile name="WiFiName" key=clearApne save Wi-Fi ka password dekho (WiFiName ki jagah naam likho)
systeminfoComputer ki poori jaankari (RAM, Windows version)
verWindows ka version dekho
hostnameComputer ka naam dekho
whoamiAbhi login user ka naam dekho
tasklistChal rahe saare programs ki list
taskkill /im notepad.exe /fAtka hua program band karo (notepad.exe ki jagah program ka naam)
dateDate dekho / badlo
timeTime dekho / badlo
dirFolder ki files aur folders dekho
cd ..Ek folder peeche jao
cd DesktopDesktop folder mein jao
mkdir MyFolderNayi folder banao
start notepadNotepad kholo
start calcCalculator kholo
shutdown /s /t 6060 second baad computer band karo
shutdown /aShutdown cancel karo
shutdown /r /t 0Computer turant restart karo
sfc /scannowWindows ki kharab files theek karo (Admin CMD mein)
helpSaare commands ki list
exitCMD band karo
